北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京小雨又降温，体感 -2℃ 真是冷，别忘带伞多添衣哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is rainy and cold at 3℃, feels like -2℃. Don't forget your umbrella and warm clothes!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波小雨，湿度 100% 真是湿漉漉。雨天路滑，外出请带好雨具。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo has light rain, 100% humidity makes it very damp. Roads might be slick, take your umbrella out.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天 15℃，体感舒适。湿度大，注意室内通风保持清爽。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast at 15℃, feels pleasant. High humidity, remember to ventilate indoors.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云 22℃，体感温暖。湿度较高，注意防潮保持舒适。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is partly cloudy at 22℃, feels warm. High humidity, keep dry and comfortable.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云 24℃，体感舒适。午后紫外线可能强，记得防晒。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is partly cloudy at 24℃, feels comfy. UV might be strong this afternoon, remember sunscreen.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州小雨 15℃，体感 12℃ 略凉。雨具随身，别忘了添件外套。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has light rain at 15℃, feels 12℃ and a bit cool. Carry your umbrella and grab a jacket.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阵雨 14℃，体感 10℃ 偏凉。风力 3 级，出行注意防风保暖。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has showers at 14℃, feels 10℃ and cool. With level 3 winds, stay warm and guard against wind.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天 14℃，体感 12℃ 凉爽。湿度适中，保持好心情。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast at 14℃, feels 12℃ and cool. Moderate humidity, keep a good mood!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉中雨 13℃，体感 8℃ 湿冷。风雨较大，请您务必注意安全保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan has moderate rain at 13℃, feels 8℃ and damp-cold. Strong wind and rain, please stay safe and warm.
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天 9℃，体感 7℃ 较凉。湿度高，早晚出行记得多添衣。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast at 9℃, feels 7℃ and cool. High humidity, remember to wear more in the morning and evening.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天 17℃，体感舒适。风力 3 级，户外活动注意防风。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast at 17℃, feels comfy. With level 3 winds, remember to guard against wind when outdoors.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，气温 -12℃，体感 -16℃ 极寒。请务必全副武装，注意防冻！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but extremely cold at -12℃, feels like -16℃. Please bundle up completely and prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -16℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天 -2℃，体感 -6℃。注意保暖，室内记得多补水。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is overcast at -2℃, feels -6℃. Stay warm, and remember to hydrate indoors.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天 15℃，体感舒适。湿度高，适度增减衣物以免着凉。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast at 15℃, feels comfy. High humidity, adjust clothes to avoid catching a cold.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云 22℃，风力 4 级体感较凉。海边风大，出门注意防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is partly cloudy at 22℃, feels cooler with level 4 winds. Windy by the sea, guard against wind outdoors.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天 13℃，风力 5 级体感 9℃。风大，出门记得多添衣保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is overcast at 13℃, feels 9℃ with level 5 winds. It's windy, remember to wear more and stay warm.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阵雪 2℃，体感 -4℃ 又大风。请务必注意防风防滑，多穿暖！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian has snow showers at 2℃, feels -4℃ with strong winds. Be sure to guard against wind and slippery roads, dress warmly!

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦阴天 22℃，体感温暖舒适。湿度 80%，注意保持室内干爽。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is overcast at 22℃, feels warm and comfy. Humidity is 80%, keep your indoor space dry.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪小雨，湿度近 100%。雨天路滑，出行小心别着凉。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has light rain, nearly 100% humidity. Roads might be slick, take care and stay warm.
